Which of the following statement/s is/are correct about the tripartite struggle?
a. Rashtrakuta king Dhruva from south India jumped into the fight.
b. ‘Tripartite Struggle’ i.e struggle among three powers
c. Gurjara-Pratiharas, could continue to maintain their hold over Kannauj till the end
With whom did the Rashtrakutas fight to capture Kanauj?
x:
The Rashtrakutas participated in the famous Tripartite Struggle for the control of Kanauj, one of the richest and most prestigious cities of North India. The three competing dynasties were: • Rashtrakutas • Gurjara-Pratiharas • Palas of Bengal The struggle continued for nearly two centuries and none of the dynasties could permanently retain Kanauj.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
